personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (with 7 Dark-First Utility structural influence)
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, premium operating system for live music, combining Spotify's rich dark glass surfaces with Linear's strict, utilitarian typography and deep contrast.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for cinematic feel (Glass/Luxe), but tight, list-first content blocks within cards (Dark-First Utility). Always respect thumb zone for primary CTAs.

do's: Use heavy frosted glass on bottom tab bar, floating actions (FAB), and sticky headers.
Use a translucent brand-tinted base layer underneath the glass to ensure text readability.
Apply subtle grain/noise overlays over glass layers for premium Luxe texture.
Use frosted overlays on featured gig hero cards over dark concert imagery.
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields.
Don't stack more than 2 glass surfaces (e.g., sticky header + bottom tab bar is fine, don't add floating glass cards in between).
Avoid weak blur where underlying text/details fight with foreground readability.

screens.name: Auth / Role Selection
screens.purpose: Frictionless entry and selection between Musician and Organizer roles.

Each card has a subtle photo backdrop, heavy bottom-up scrim, and tight, scannable metadata rows (Linear-style dense info) below the title.

screens.name: Gig Detail
screens.purpose: Immersive breakdown of a gig's requirements and application action.

Middle content includes dense, list-first metadata (Pay, Location, Equipment) with Phosphor outlined icons.

screens.name: Musician Profile

screens.name: Organizer Dashboard
screens.purpose: Utilitarian command center for tracking events, applications, and payments.

states.empty: Icon + 'No active events' + primary CTA 'Create Event'.

screens.layout: Strict grid structure. Large metrics (applicants, budget spent) using display font. Dense, easily scannable list of active gigs with status badges (brandTertiary for 'Hiring', surfaceTertiary for 'Filled'). Functional, no-nonsense UI.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided. The app runs in DARK mode by default with deep obsidian backgrounds (zinc-950) and a sophisticated Ruby/Crimson accent.
Implement the 'Spotify + Linear' layout model: use immersive hero images and large typography (Spotify) paired with ultra-clean, tightly spaced metadata rows and scannable lists (Linear).
Ensure all interactive surfaces over scrolling content use heavy glassmorphism with a translucent tinted base layer to guarantee text readability.
Any text overlaid on hero images MUST use a vertical linear-gradient scrim (transparent to >70% surfaceInverse or black).
Primary call-to-action buttons must always be sticky at the bottom of the screen (above the safe area), never buried within scrolling content.
Use 'Geist' for high-density UI elements (stats, metadata, tags) and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for large editorial headlines.
Include subtle haptic feedback on all major interactions (applying for gigs, switching tabs, toggling filters).
